text:
alex: heads up — last-minute coordination for tonight's change window (2026-03-24 23:00 UTC). API team wants to pin api-service -> v2.4.1, runtime plans to roll runtime -> v3.0.0-rc2 (kv eviction fix), console UI will deploy commit abc123, router needs header-swap config v5.1. Who's owning rollback criteria and final deploy order? @deploy-bot can you queue preflight?
maria: staging smoke passed for api v2.4.1 and console abc123. runtime-rc2 has one flaky test but perf looks ok. link: https://staging.redwood/ci/9876 :white_check_mark:
sam: noted. runtime-rc2 memory profile looked slightly higher at long sessions — if we see rising RSS or worker restarts > 1/min we should fallback to runtime v2.9.8. Also need to confirm KV cache format compatibility with api v2.4.1 (will double-check).
sasha: i'll be oncall for the window. propose rollback triggers: error-rate > 0.5% for 2 consecutive 5m windows OR p95 latency increase > 30% baseline for two windows OR worker restarts spike > 1/min. If any trigger, immediate staged rollback and traffic hold. :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: scheduled window confirmed: 2026-03-24 23:00-23:30 UTC. Preflight checks queued at T-45. Default rollback TTL: 30m. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 80% over 10m intervals. Confirmed services: api-service, runtime, router, console.
maria: KV cache format check: OK in staging; no compatibility bump needed. runtime team validated model-serving kv keys unchanged. test run: 10k requests, zero KV misses introduced.
sam: good. Rollback commands we will use (pre-approved ops steps):
```
# router rollback
ri deploy rollback --service router --to-tag stable-20260324
# runtime rollback
ri deploy rollback --service runtime --to-tag v2.9.8
# api rollback (if needed)
ri deploy rollback --service api-service --to-tag v2.4.0
```
alex: order suggestion: 1) pin api v2.4.1 2) deploy runtime v3.0.0-rc2 3) router header-swap v5.1 (canary) 4) console abc123 (post-check). Rationale: API contract pin first so runtime/console see pinned behaviour.
sasha: agree with order. add one manual approval gate before router full ramp — i.e. after 25% canary we pause for manual sign-off (T-15). Who's approving?
maria: i can approve API and console parts. runtime fallback approval should come from sam. router full ramp approval — alex?
sam: i'll watch runtime during canary and approve/fail within the 10m window. If memory or restarts trend upward i'll trigger runtime rollback command above.
deploy-bot: preflight results: config diff OK, infra capacity check OK (reserve headroom 20%), schema check OK. Canary roll steps scheduled. Posting automated smoke links to #eng-sre on start.
alex: all right — documented rollback criteria and commands in the release notes draft. I'll post the short release note to #release-notes at T-30. Anyone object to the plan?
sasha: no objections. i'll be at my desk, will notify @oncall if we hit thresholds. :thumbsup:
maria: one more note — console deploy touches settings page A/B flag. We'll gate that behind feature flag OFF by default and enable after router stable. Avoids UI surprises.
sam: ack. also adding quick heapdump cron if we see anomalies: `curl -X POST http://runtime/heapdump` — pre-authorized for oncall.
alex: perfect. i'll be online for the window. if anything changes ping here and @deploy-bot will broadcast. Good to go. :rocket:
